newsitem.title: USA: Cahners Business Confidence Index rose in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Cahners Business Confidence Index rose in Dec.

text.p: The business community embraced the holiday shopping season with "reasonably good spirits," boosting the Cahners Business Confidence Index (CBCI) one point between November and December, according to a report by Cahners Economics.
The CBCI rose to 66.2 in December from 65.2 in November, the report said.
"The business community, in good spirits this holiday season, is expecting a happy new year in terms of employment, production and several other key business measures," it said.
